query.text: 请帮我照看小狗，有需要关注的表现或需求时告诉我，照看结束时简要总结它的情况。
query.text_en: Please watch over the puppy, tell me about behavior or needs requiring attention, and briefly summarize its condition at the end of the observation.

annotation.text_zh: 小狗叼着牵引绳在门口等，它想进屋了。
annotation.text_en: The dog is waiting at the door with its leash, ready to come inside.

annotation.text_zh: 小狗一直叼着牵引绳在门口等，想进屋呢。
